decisions.reason: Changing SPI MOSI from GPIO33 to GPIO47 preserves the already selected ESP32-S3 WROOM-1 module and does not alter its selection state.
The source changes only the SPI MOSI assignment; the 5V boost enable remains assigned to GPIO5 and its control behavior is unchanged.
The addressable LEDs use GPIO13 for data and GPIO5 for shared-rail control; neither assignment nor the LED power and level-shifting behavior is changed by the SPI MOSI reassignment.
The SPI MOSI pin change does not alter the DCDC1 voltage, current rating, load coverage, or regulation behavior.
The standalone USB-powered 3.3V rail and source-selection behavior remain valid independently of the SPI MOSI GPIO assignment.
The source does not change the sensor board's role as a connector fanout or any documented sensor-port requirement.
The charge-status interfaces use the SK6812 chain on GPIO13 and the separate CHGLED circuit; the SPI MOSI reassignment changes neither interface.
Battery electrical protection and its AXP2101 and DW01A-related parameters are unaffected by the SPI MOSI GPIO change.
The battery NTC connection and AXP2101 thermal-protection behavior do not depend on the SPI MOSI assignment.
The AXP2101 battery and system power path remains unchanged by moving SPI MOSI to GPIO47.
The GPIO reassignment does not change the four-board architecture, board count, or board identities.
